briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race intensifies as multi-agent systems mature

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs push next-gen models with enhanced reasoning while regulatory scrutiny grows. Funding remains robust amid global AI infrastructure expansion. Key vulnerabilities persist in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with advanced agent orchestration. Anthropic's Claude 4.1 and DeepSeek R2 show competitive gains. Meta's Llama 4 open weights drive adoption.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp accelerates with TSMC capacity deals. Microsoft and Google expand dedicated AI data centers in Texas and Arizona. Energy constraints emerge as bottleneck.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems by end of 2027?
